now.title: Spider-Man (1994)#54
now.text: Keene Marlow, secretly the Destroyer of the Six, is an old friend of Ben's. He visits May after Peter's wedding, and she introduces him to Peter.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Keene Marlow, an old friend of Ben's.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The wife of Keene's old friend Ben.

proposed.text: Keene Marlow, an old friend of Ben's, visits May after Peter's wedding, and she introduces him to Peter.

changes.evidence: In Spider-Man (1994)#54 (Six Forgotten Warriors, Chapter I) Keene appears only as Commander Keene Marlow, an old friend of Ben's. He is first shown as the Destroyer in #56 (Secrets of the Six, in flashback) and fights as the Destroyer from #57, so 'secretly the Destroyer of the Six' in a #54 stage gives away a later reveal.
changes.source: https://marvel.fandom.com/api.php?action=parse&page=Spider-Man_(1994_animated_series)_Season_5_4&prop=wikitext&format=json (Destroyer listed as 1st appearance as Destroyer); https://marvel.fandom.com/api.php?action=parse&page=Spider-Man_(1994_animated_series)_Season_5_2&prop=wikitext&format=json (listed as Commander Keene Marlow)

now.title: Spider-Man (1994)#60
now.text: After their honeymoon, Mary Jane turns out to be a clone made by Miles Warren, and she dissolves. Peter then sets out with Madame Web to find the real Mary Jane.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Peter marries her clone, then sets out to find her.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Marries Mary Jane's clone, then comes looking for her.

proposed.text: On their honeymoon, Mary Jane turns out to be a clone made by Miles Warren, and she dissolves. Peter then sets out with Madame Web to find the real Mary Jane.

changes.evidence: The clone reveal happens during the honeymoon, not after it: in #59 (The Return of Hydro-Man, Part 1) Peter and Mary Jane arrive at Niagara Falls for their postponed honeymoon and Hydro-Man kidnaps her; in #60 (Part 2) she is revealed as Miles Warren's clone and dissolves, and Madame Web offers to take Peter to find the real Mary Jane.
